name: Cut-Throat Alley
summary: In Cut-Throat Alley, a hidden courtyard lies beyond a canal shop in Stormwind City. Its paved path ends at an empty residence, out of sight of ordinary city traffic.

sections.title: A Secluded Nook
sections.body:
Step through the Shady Lady and a paved dead end opens before you. Stacked crates and forgotten barrels sit beside a two-story residence with no one at home. Though the alley is counted within the Dwarven District, it lies apart from the district's forge fires and soot.

No main avenue reaches Cut-Throat Alley. Its only footpath passes through the canal-side shop, just south of the bridge from Cathedral Square. Passing guards and ordinary citizens cannot see this quiet corner of the capital.

faq.q: How do you get to Cut-Throat Alley?
faq.answer: Follow the canal front along the edge of the Dwarven District, just south of the footbridge to Cathedral Square. Find the Shady Lady and pass through the shop to reach the alley.

faq.q: Why does the map call this the Dwarven District?
aliases: why does it say dwarven district
faq.answer: Cut-Throat Alley lies within the Dwarven District's bounds and is usually counted as part of it. It has none of the district's smoke and no street connection. Enter through the Shady Lady on the canal front.

faq.q: Is anyone living in Cut-Throat Alley?
aliases: who lives in cut throat alley
faq.answer: No one lives in Cut-Throat Alley. Its only house, a two-story residence, is abandoned. Stacked cargo crates and empty barrels are all that remain; there are no residents, shopkeepers, or city watchmen.

faq.q: Are there any quests in Cut-Throat Alley?
faq.answer: No formal duties or civic assignments lead into Cut-Throat Alley. It remains an overlooked, secluded corner of the capital.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can reach this unpatrolled dead end only through the rear door of a shady canal shop. It offers a hideout beyond the Stormwind City Guard's sight.
